title: Fast Shortest Path in Graphs With Sparse Signed Tree Models and Applications
summary: A signed tree model of a graph $G$ is a compact binary structure consisting of a rooted binary tree whose leaves are bijectively mapped to the vertices of $G$, together with 2-colored edges $xy$, called transversal pairs, interpreted as bicliques or anti-bicliques whose sides are the leaves of the subtrees rooted at $x$ and at $y$. We design an algorithm that, given such a representation of an $n$-vertex graph $G$ with $p$ transversal pairs and a source $v \in V(G)$, computes a shortest-path tree rooted at $v$ in $G$ in time $O(p \log n)$.
